info.name: RESpark Inventory & Stock Management API Test Suite
info.description: Comprehensive Postman test collection for the RESpark Inventory & Stock Management module built strictly from the video reference and UI screens. Includes Authentication, Dashboard Summary, Vendor Management (full CRUD & validation), Purchase Orders (lifecycle, calculations, partial/full receive, rejection, cancellations), Transfer Requests (same location rejection, stock availability check, dispatch & receive), Centralized Approvals Inbox, Stock Reconciliation (positive/negative adjustments, bulk reconciliation, CSV export), and Security & Input testing.
